response.content:
For \(v=0.96c\),

\[
\gamma=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-0.96^2}}=\frac{25}{7}\approx 3.5714286
\]

Li with 3 neutrons is \({}^6\mathrm{Li}\). Using the tabulated Li-6 mass energy gives rest energy \(\approx 5.6031\ \text{GeV}\). Thus the total relativistic energy is

\[
E=\gamma mc^2 \approx 3.5714286(5.6031)\approx 20.011\ \text{GeV}
\]

Answer: A
